title: Unisex Rottweiler – On Guard. (Asleep.) Hoodie

seo.title: Rottweiler Hoodie – On Guard. (Asleep.)
seo.description: A funny rottweiler hoodie for Rottie owners: ON GUARD. (ASLEEP.) Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

ON GUARD. (ASLEEP.) is the rottweiler hoodie for the owner whose guard dog naps through every delivery, worn on dog walks, on the porch and as a gift from a family that knows how the watch really goes.

ON GUARD. fills the top in heavy slab capitals and (ASLEEP.) fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a big rottweiler with proper black-and-tan markings sleeps on its back on a doormat, paws in the air and tongue out, in front of a red front door with a delivery box left untouched on the step.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the porch scene; Sand gets dark brown and deep rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this rottweiler hoodie warm enough for porch evenings and cool dog walks?
Yes. The On Guard. (Asleep.) hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cool dog walks, porch evenings and weekends at home.

How does the On Guard. (Asleep.) hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a rottweiler owner?
It is a natural one. Every Rottie owner has a guard dog that sleeps through the doorbell, so it lands with dog-park friends, neighbors and the family that knows how the watch really goes. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the porch scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the On Guard. (Asleep.) hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
